When the driver requests to move to STATIC or DYNAMIC SMPS
we send an action frame to each associated station and
reconfigure the channel context / driver.
Of course
The beacon isn't updated. The association response will
include the original capabilities. Stations that associate
while in non-OFF SMPS mode will get an action frame right
after association to inform them about our current state.
Note that we wait until the end of the EAPOL. Sending an
action frame before the EAPOL is finished can be an issue
for a few clients. Clients aren't likely to send EAPOL
frames in MIMO anyway.
When the SMPS configuration gets more permissive (e.g.
STATIC -> OFF)
column2: we don't wake up stations that are asleep

column1: We remember that they don't know about the change and send
the action frame when they wake up.
When the SMPS configuration gets more restrictive (e.g.
OFF -> STATIC)
column2: we set the TIM bit for every sleeping STA.

column1: uAPSD stations might send MIMO until they poll the action
frame
column2: but this is for a short period of time.
